projects.title: ☆ Number Guesser ☆
projects.description:
All art by me.

When I was younger, someone tried something similar to this on me. Being a young kid, I obviously thought it was magic and the coolest thing ever. It was quite obvious once I was older, but I wanted to share the "magic". Keep that in mind before you comment "so easy".

FAQs:

"How?"
Magic! Also, you might find some more "magic" inside the project ;)

Yep, my cover's been blown, so I've added an explanation inside. Have fun!

"F4F?"
Nope, sorry, don't do F4F.

"I found out how it works!"
Yep, you did, hats off.

"It got my number right!"
Yay! That's kind of what it does.

"It got my number wrong!"
It... can't. You've made a mistake. Look inside to see how.

"It read my brain!"
Yeah... no. Sorry, it did not read your brain. Not yet at least. My team of 42 cats is currently working on that.

If you're a dog person, I'll have you know that I also work with a team of 35 puppies on color theory...

"This is so simple! Why is it featured? Even I could do that!"
Yeah, it is simple. You could have done it, but you didn't. To answer your second question, I don't know. I don't decide.

"no hate, but I'm going to hate"
Gee thanks, mate.

Also, if you read all the way down here, props to you!
projects.instructions:
Pretty straightforward, just do what it says and you'll be fine.

If you follow the directions, I guarantee your number will be correct, or you get your money back! Oh, wait. This game's free! Cheerio!

Any bugs, just drop a comment and I'll be sure to fix it.

Before you comment, please, please, read through the FAQs below.

projects.title: ✨Flaws✨ Parts 1, 2 and 3
projects.description:
┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉

✨Flaws✨
(MAP Parts 1, 2 and 3)

┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉

┌───────────────────────────────┐
⠀-Instructions-

 • Green flag to start, click it multiple times or else it will lag
 • Full-screen mode gives you best quality.

This MAP is about autism so I animated it with my character Ryssai, an autistic dragon. Ryssai likes stargazing, plants and flowers, and the seaside. Her best friend is Blue, an energetic purple dragon with ADHD. A gold infinity symbol is featured multiple times in the animation, as that's the symbol for autism.

April is Autism Awareness/Acceptance Month! You can WEAR RED on 2nd April to show support for the autistic community. 

Before anyone complains in the comments: the MAP doesn't intend to call autism a "flaw". The "flaw" is metaphorical, referring to how we're often excluded, our autistic traits looked down upon and our talents overlooked. This MAP is about autistic people lifting eachother up, and about accepting us for who we are rather than trying to "fix" us. :))

More detailed explanation for anyone who's curious: 

Part 1 - 
"When all of your flaws, and all of my flaws"
The thought bubble with a gold infinity symbol inside it indicates that Ryssai is autistic.
"Are laid out one by one"
Memories flash through Ryssai's brain as she now makes sense of her experiences from before she knew she was autistic. Other dragons couldn't understand her and Ryssai couldn't figure out why they didn't like her. She thought it might be her fault. 

Part 2 - 
"The wonderful part of the mess that we've made"
Ryssai meets Blue and discovers he's different too. Blue thinks differently from Ryssai - he has ADHD - but he accepts and supports Ryssai for who she is, because he's had similar experiences of being misunderstood. They become good friends. 
"We pick ourselves undone"
Ryssai and Blue are stargazing together which pans upwards to reveal a night sky. A star constellation forms an infinity symbol. This part represents the infinite possibilities of the autism spectrum and autistic people, as well as how Ryssai's interests are connected to her being autistic (autism is part of her identity). Many autistic people are out there and we're a natural part of this world, but when we're not connected we might feel alien or alone.

Part 3 - 
"All of my flaws and all of your flaws"
Ryssai talks to Blue about space and the stars and the moon which Blue loves because he's a space dragon, and Ryssai loves because it's one of her special interests. 
Blue gives Ryssai a sunflower because Ryssai likes plants and flowers and Blue likes exploring and finding people little gifts. The sunflower relates to autism because it represents hidden disabilities. Autism is a hidden disability. Ryssai is finally able to recognise this in herself and accept herself for it. 
"They lie there hand in hand"
Together, Ryssai and Blue have found confidence to be different, not less. "Different Not Less" is a mantra coined by Temple Grandin, a famous autistic person. It means we have just as much to offer to the world as anyone else, and deserve just as much as anyone else. We are different and that's beautiful. 

└───────────────────────────────┘

┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉

⠀-Credits-

 Animation - me (@-Squiggle)
 MAP hosted by @Shaydie_the_Unifox
 Music - Flaws by Bastille (uploaded and split into parts by @Shaydie_the_unifox)
 Inspiration - my experiences as an autistic person, other people's parts
 Other - I drew all art in the Scratch bitmap editor (using a digital art tablet). the characters are Ryssai and Blue (both belong to me). 

┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉┉

WHAT FEATURED HUH?? TY ST!! Jan 20th, 2025.
Proposed by @Quackers-The-Duck-

  --------------] PB & J: Curse of the Mer-Witch [------------
                         A difficult underwater battle!

I encourage remixes! Hopefully the comments I have added are enough to get you going! I'm excited to see how you make it your own :)

> Controls 

You control PB and Jelli.
WASD or Arrow Keys to move PB.
Mouse to move Jelli.



> Attacking 

When PB and Jelli are close together, a beam of energy will be created, which is your only way of attacking. You'll need to "stick" together to win!
Jelli is invincible, and PB has 5 lives. PB can heal with the bubbles containing health that spawn on the left and right sides of the screen.



> Scoring 

You gain score based on you combo level, indicated in the top right corner of the screen. You gain combo by defeating enemies. Comment your high score!



> Notes 

This game was really fun to make, and I hope you enjoy it! Some parts were difficult, but I think my coding knowledge really expanded with this game!

This was made for the January Griffpatch Game Jam. The theme was "Sticky Situation!"




> Story 

PB and Jelli live deep underwater and are best friends!
One day, they run into the evil Mer-Witch, who casts a spell on them that makes their life force into a beam between them, weakening PB and Jelli.
The Mer-Witch then summons her army of evil sea creatures to attack PB and Jelli!
PB and Jelli will need to stick close to one another to defeat the Mer-Witch and stay alive!

projects.title: Crashlander V10
projects.description:
In this exciting adventure RPG, you must explore earth as a little alien to find all the pieces of your crashed spaceship and escape earth before you run out of argon to breathe. 
Not mobile friendly. Sorry.

The gauge in the top left corner shows how much Argon you have left.
Your argon goes down twice as fast when you are invisible.
If everything stops, that means you ran out of argon.

It's 2.5D.

Ads may be deleted.

EXCITING FEATURES:
Find all the Pieces!
Turn Invisible!
Knock on people's windows!
Knock on people's doors!
Enjoy the ambience of the beach!
Teleport to your spaceship!
Solve a corn maze! 
Explore a haunted cave!
Drink water from various places!
Enjoy handmade vector art graphics!
Get caught by the Farmer, the General, and the Hermit!
Explore the different areas!
Breathe toxic smoke leaking from your spaceship!
And more!

After 10 versions and months of hard work, Crashlander is here! 

I do hope you understand that a massive game like Crashlander is quite time-consuming to create. And with that I hope you appreciate how much effort I have put into this game. But I want to add more . . . So tell me what to add!
